findings.message: The param membroEquipeId selects a member but no request writes the selection. Added public selectMembroEquipe(id | null) and the getter cadastroPessoa (row of the loaded pessoas list by id). Selecting fills the edit draft from the row; an unresolvable id publishes client.selectionInvalid.

The param busca filters pessoasEquipe but no state holds it. Added the persisted public state busca (string | null); qryPessoasEquipe(busca?, page, append) publishes it and sends it as the optional input busca.

cmdCadastrarPessoa and cmdSalvarAlteracoes have typed inputs but no <command>.input state. Added cmdCadastrarPessoaDraft (setCmdCadastrarPessoaDraft) and cmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft (setCmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft); the edit draft is filled from the selected record and carries id and version.

cmdCadastrarPessoa returns the new person but the contract has no way to know the name ordering or whether it matches the active busca. The person is inserted at the end of the loaded items in pessoas (upsert by id) without reordering or filtering; the pages may reload qryPessoasEquipe to get the backend order.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
